notes.title: Achievements Unlocked for Assassin's Creed Chronicles!
notes.content:
[h2]🔓 Achievements Unlocked! 🔓[/h2]

 
Platform into this 2.5D side-scroller for a stealth adventure!

 
Journey through 3 different countries as Shao Jun, Arbazz Mir, and Nikolai Orelov as they journey on their own path following a pre-cursor artifact.

 
[i][b]Achievements will be retroactively earned for those accomplishments already completed in your journey upon launching the game.[/b][/i]
